mapper.select: SELECT emp_id, emp_name, department, position, entry_date, graduation_date, education, school, major, professional_title, product_group, projects, residence, computer_subsidy, month_salary_rate, day_rate FROM employee_profile WHERE emp_name = #{keyword} OR emp_id = #{keyword} LIMIT 5

SELECT emp_id, emp_name, department, position, entry_date, graduation_date, education, school, major, professional_title, product_group, projects, residence, computer_subsidy, month_salary_rate, day_rate FROM employee_profile WHERE emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR department LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR projects LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 10
